population_scope.description: Label-blind 42-subject repeat-session reference subset used for T0 descriptive Function/Limit discovery.

reference_scheme_scope: Average reference as declared in pinned raw release metadata; reference sensitivity is not yet closed as a P0-Q claim.
exclusions: No clinical or cognitive field used to construct the descriptive reference artifact
No modal damping ratio or local chi admitted
scope: Exploratory label-blind reference and repeatability artifact for the frozen ds003775 repeat subset. It is not a clinical normative model and cannot support diagnosis or prognosis.
known_limitations: Only 42 repeat subjects and one acquisition family are represented.
No covariate model is fitted in this P0-D artifact.
Exact peak count shows limited repeat agreement.
Aperiodic model-family disagreement is substantial in many sessions.
Channel-wise repeatability is heterogeneous and has not been separated from montage/reference or peripheral artifact effects.
First-listed peak centers are not treated as mode identities across sessions.
No modal estimator has yet passed the frozen real-EEG admission program.
No externally validated reference threshold exists.
